Why Chinese founders use DomainHunter
01
Availability matches the registry

.cn / .com.cn are checked against CNNIC WHOIS, .com and others against registry RDAP, cross-checked with DNS. Taken names are dropped — no word-list guessing, no stale cache.

02
Expiry dates and prices, together

Taken names show the registry's expiry date so you can wait for a drop; available names show live registrar and renewal prices, with RMB reference prices for TLDs like .cn.

03
Bulk checks and drop monitoring

Paste up to 200 names for one bulk check and export CSV without using AI quota; watch a taken name you love — it is rechecked every 6 hours and any drop is logged to your monitor feed.
